units.note: Checked negations, μὲν/δέ contrasts (Callisthenes vs Timaeus), names (Timoleon, Callisthenes, Alexander, Ephorus, Demochares), no numbers, no lacunae. Only nuance: ἀφιλοτίμως rendered 'without any critical care' (more literally 'without contentiousness/partisan zeal'); not clearly wrong, no fix proposed.

The three *** lacunae are marked [...] in the English and not smoothed. Names (Dionysius the tyrant, Aristotle, Homer as 'the poet') and sense of οὐ μὴν ἀλλά / καθάπερ εἰ παρόντας μὴ παρεῖναι are correct.
